company.description:
Arimo is an information technology company that specializes in the fields of big data, machine learning, business analytics, visualizations, and data intelligence. It harnesses the behaviors of machines, devices, customers, and other entities to provide the most accurate predictions utilizing Deep Learning.

The company was founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California.
